document.name: RU-74-01,R2_GENERIC_PROCEDURE_FOR_AOV_DIAGNOSTIC_T.md
document.title: Generic Procedure for AOV Diagnostic Testing

items.statement: The test leader establishes program scope, maintains controlled procedures, and oversees AOV maintenance and testing; engineers define criteria and analyze results.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: - Identify and define AOV test requirements and acceptance criteria.

items.statement: The written test procedure directs field installation and acquisition of AOV diagnostic signatures used to evaluate design performance.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: This test procedure provides instructions to field personnel for the installation and acquisition of Air Operated Valves (AOV) diagnostic signatures by using CRANE NUCLEAR's UDS on selected AOV's.

items.statement: The procedure supports as-found, as-left, post-maintenance, set-point, and periodic verification testing against defined acceptance criteria.

sources.source_locator: 1.2 Scope and 8. Acceptance Criteria, pages 3 and 27, lines 76-87 and 715-717

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Acceptance criteria encompass the set of critical parameters for selected diagnostic testing type.

items.criterion_name: Control of Measuring and Test Equipment
items.statement: Calibration of all diagnostic equipment is verified before use and calibrated tools are recorded on field data sheets.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 6.5 Verify the calibration of all equipment before its use.

items.statement: Equipment clearance and test tags identify controlled test status before and after work.

sources.source_locator: 6. Prerequisites and 7.4 As Found Test Performance, pages 13 and 22, lines 397 and 666-670

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 6.8 Request an equipment clearance (e.g. test tag) for the task specified on the work package.

items.statement: Work stops when a problem is found, deficiencies are documented, and unacceptable test results are submitted for engineering disposition.

sources.source_locator: 5.8 Precautions and Limitations and 7.4 As Found Test Performance, pages 11 and 22, lines 339 and 676

evidence_quotes.quote_original: When a problem is discovered, work shall stop.

items.statement: Engineering evaluates degraded conditions, determines operability, and defines required corrective action.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: An engineering evaluation of degradations should be performed to determine required corrective actions.

items.statement: Test equipment, deficiencies, diagnostic data, analysis, and reports are recorded in field data sheets and test packages.

sources.source_locator: 6. Prerequisites and 7.4 As Found Test Performance, pages 13 and 22, lines 393 and 666

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 6.6 All calibrated tools and equipment that are used, shall be recorded on appropriate Field Data Sheets.
